decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system serves a specialized defense niche with long procurement cycles, so its value is still uncertain, it is cheap to keep listed, and rising naval spending supports holding the option open.

The general interior luminaire went from a dedicated page to a mere mention, but it is a second-generation core LED product with low carrying cost in the firm's main business, so dropping it is not yet justified.
The microprismatic pendant was actively promoted as a latest release in 2024, which signals growing commitment and an option whose uncertainty is still resolving favorably.

The marine searchlight survived the removal of its HMI sibling, likely as the retained LED variant in the marine line, and remains on the website, though the pruning of that line suggests some risk that it is dropped too.
